title: Ainekio V2 hybrid artwork set

designReference.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a new Ainekio V2 HYBRID concept image for the robot's website, wide cinematic 16:9.
Input image 1 is ORIGINAL AINEKIO V1: this is the dominant identity reference, especially its squat stout body, arched crimson ice-axe-like legs with serrated edges, exposed multicolored wiring, black compact chassis and small cyan emoticon face.
Input image 2 is the previous V2 concept. Keep ONLY the idea of three compact actuator joints per leg and some supported parallel-link engineering. The user says this version looks too much like Harmony recolored. You MUST substantially redesign its silhouette.
Requested hybrid:
- A much shorter, wider, STOUT low central body, approximately 30 percent shorter nose-to-tail than image 2, and broader across the shoulders. Compact sturdy crab/robot-familiar stance rather than a long skinny robot dog.
- Exactly FOUR substantial crimson curved legs inspired strongly by original Ainekio. Each lower leg resembles the curved head/pick of an ICE AXE: a bold hooked arc with clearly visible serrated/toothed inner or rear edge, ending in a practical contact tip. The red serrated legs must be the dominant instantly recognizable silhouette. Preserve original Ainekio's printed angular red aesthetic, adapting it into new articulated three-joint limbs.
- No smooth silver teardrop legs, no loop-shaped feet, no long polished silver limbs from Harmony. Dark supporting linkages and compact exposed black micro-servos are acceptable behind the crimson outer members.
- Keep short broad crimson front housing with the familiar small friendly cyan OLED emoticon face, dark open body frame, compact vented central electronics bay and a modest lively bundle of colored wires. A slightly integrated top electronics deck but still clearly a home-built printed machine. Realistic bolts, pivots, layer lines and modest wear. Do not invent oversized military armor.
Composition: ONE complete robot seen from a low front-three-quarter angle, all four legs readable and inside the frame, robot taking about 70 percent of the frame, on wet broken concrete in the original ruined dystopian futuristic city. Rain reflections, storm-blue light, restrained teal rim lighting and distant ember-red fires. Same cool cinematic sci-fi illustration style as the existing Ainekio artwork. The friendly scrappy familiar character matters more than sleek product styling.
The viewer should immediately read this as an evolution of ORIGINAL AINEKIO, with stout stance and ICE-AXE SERRATED RED LEGS, not a recolored Harmony robot. This is prospective design concept art, not manufacturing documentation.
No text, logos, watermarks, weapons, humans, extra limbs, silver loop feet, elongated thin dog body, or generic Boston Dynamics-style anatomy.

note: Prospective editorial concepts. Final geometry, electronics, materials, wiring and dimensions remain subject to engineering and physical testing. The V1-to-V2 comparison deliberately preserves V1 on the left.
